stable_core.results: R[T,E] with explicit Ok/Err tags; ? only in result-returning functions, propagating from the current function
stable_core.calls: required name: expression value arguments; source-order evaluation
stable_core.partial_application: partial f(key:expression); pure eager snapshot captures; latent effects retained
stable_core.defaults: scalar literal declarations; explicit key:default selection; no omitted keys
stable_core.bindings: let is immutable; mut name = value permits local rebinding
stable_core.collections: eager map/filter/reduce; explicit mapping/filtering/compose plans and transduce/collect terminals
stable_core.transducers: Transform[Input,Output]; immutable pure stateless stages; per-item first-then order; no intermediate data lists
stable_core.records: closed schemas; all source fields explicitly keyed; nested validation; declaration module identity
stable_core.json: json.decode[T] requires schema; reject missing required/unknown/duplicate fields, wrong types and out-of-range/non-integer i32 text; omitted optionals become nil; no internal metadata on wire
stable_core.strings: Go quoted-string escapes; source spelling preserved by fmt; interpolation inserts data once without re-evaluation
stable_core.variants: type Error { variant Missing { key:str } variant Offline {} }; pure keyed constructors Error.Missing(key:value), Error.Offline(); module identity retained
stable_core.patterns: explicit let payload binders or _; no executed calls/interpolation; exhaustive total declared-variant arms, no catch-all; known R covers Ok/Err or wildcard; nested when for payload decisions
stable_core.error_conversion: explicit typed functions and exhaustive when; no implicit wrapping or union inference
stable_core.loops: for item in finiteList { ... }; immutable iteration binding, scoped locals, outer mut updates, return and ?
stable_core.body_checking: all bodies must parse executable grammar; unknown identifiers rejected; some unknown expression types deferred to runtime
stable_core.return_paths: non-nil return contracts need an explicit return on every successful path; loops may be empty and ? may succeed; nil/optional/Any fallthrough admitted

tests: return nil or R[nil,E]; ? requires a result-returning function

agent_handoff.edit_scope: Read the vendored skill before editing .ki files.
agent_handoff.version_pin: .kiro/version.json records compiler release fields, guide revision and language reference schema/path/SHA-256.

experimental_areas: editor tooling breadth beyond the current LSP baseline

agent_tools.diagnostics: stable native codes and structured fields; first compiler error; legacy fallback categories; declaration spans are not expression edit targets
agent_tools.symbols: declared contracts only; syntax validation; source snapshot SHA-256; no resolved caller graph
agent_tools.lsp: shared semantic diagnostics with unsaved overlays; zero-based UTF-16 ranges; project root recommended

optional_analysis.policy: agents choose cost/benefit; users opt into hooks; no background or mandatory analysis
optional_analysis.static: graph/impact/metrics/cycles/boundaries/rules/slice; possible and unresolved dependencies explicit; boundary proposals do not refactor code
optional_analysis.dynamic: coverage traces Kiro functions/statements/branches per test; mutate explicitly selects a covered function; subprocess timeouts and budgets
optional_analysis.limits: no complete interprocedural points-to/heap analysis, field-sensitive slicing, architectural optimum or automatic behavior-preserving refactor proof
